description: Fetch a public web page plus up to 4 pages on the same host that it links to (in link order, or only those whose path starts with `prefix`), and return each one as title + clean Markdown. Good for reading a docs section or a small site in one call. No model call, deterministic. For a single page use page_to_markdown (cheaper), for metadata only use page_metadata. Plain HTTP fetch (no JavaScript rendering, 15 s timeout, only the first 2 MB is read). Errors (non-public URL, upstream HTTP error, timeout, non-text content) return isError with the reason and are never charged. Price: $0.03 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; nothing is charged for a bad input). First $0.1 of calls per day per client are free (no payment needed).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (x402 v2 payment payload signed for one entry of the `accepts` list returned when this tool is called without it). Omit to get the price and payment requirements.

prefix.description: Only follow links whose path starts with this, e.g. /docs/

name: crawl_site
title: Read a page + 4 linked pages ($0.03/call)
